newsitem.title: ITALY: FIAT NOT SEEKING AUTOMAKERS STAKE.
newsitem.headline: FIAT NOT SEEKING AUTOMAKERS STAKE.

text.p: Italy's Fiat said on Friday is was not interested in acquiring a stake in South African car maker Automakers Ltd.
"The report is devoid of any foundation," a spokesman said, commenting on rumours that Automakers is in talks with Fiat and Japan's Nissan on a possible tie-up.
The speculation lifted Automakers' shares to a high of 350 cents on Friday -- a gain of 70 cents on the day -- although the stock had eased back to 315 by 1210 GMT.

Automakers main subsidiary Nissan SA has licensed its name from the Japanese group and the firm also sells Fiat's Uno model. Dealers and analysts have speculated one or both of the firms are in talks with Automakers' main shareholder Sankorp over the sale of its 50.7 percent stake.
